{Call} Trash 3. Then, add 1 BRAINDANCE Program from your trash to your hand.
{Go Solo} (Pay this Legend's cost to play it as a ready Unit. It can attack this turn. If it leaves the field, remove it from the game.)

rulings.q: After you Trash 3 with the [Call] effect will you be forced to add 1 BRAINDANCE Program from the trash to your hand if there is a valid target?
If you have only 2 cards left in your deck when you resolve the [Call] effect, will you be forced to trash them?
Can you add 1 for each BRAINDANCE Program that is trashed with the [Call] effect?

name: Valentino Guerrera
ability_text: If you have more ☆ (Street Cred) than a Rival, this Unit can attack ready Units with {Blocker}.

rulings.q: If your Valentino Guerra attacks a rival Unit with [BLOCKER] that is in the ready position, can the attacked rival Unit in the ready position activate [BLOCKER] during the React step?

name: Valentino Street Racer
ability_text: {Play} Give another friendly Unit with cost 5 or less {Adrenaline} this turn. (A Unit with Adrenaline can attack the turn it's played.)

rulings.q: If you play this Unit on your rival's turn and give another friendly Unit with cost 5 or less [Adrenaline], can you now attack with that Unit on your rival's turn?

name: Viktor Vektor - Drop Your Illusions
ability_text: Play your first CYBERWARE Gear each turn for -3 €$, to a minimum of 1 €$.

rulings.q: If you play a CYBERWARE Gear on your rival's turn, will you still get the -3 €$ effect?
When playing your first CYBERWARE Gear this turn can you choose not to have the -3 €$ reduction?
When you play your first CYBERWARE Gear each turn for -3 €$, does it also reduce the cost value of the Gear you play?

name: Viktor Vektor - Sit Down and Relax
ability_text: {Call} Search the top 5 cards of your deck. Reveal up to 2 Gears with cost 2 or less and add them to your hand. Bottom-deck the rest in a random order.

rulings.q: When you search the top 5 cards of your deck with the [Call] effect, can you choose not to reveal any cards, even if there is a valid target, and instead put them on the bottom of the deck in random order?

name: Viktor Vektor - You Might Feel a Little Pinch
ability_text: {Play} Play a CYBERWARE Gear with cost 2 or less from your trash for free. Equip it only to another friendly Unit.

rulings.q: When you resolve the [Play] effect, can you choose not to play a CYBERWARE Gear costing 2 or less from your trash for free?

name: Wakako Okada - Peace and Harmony
ability_text:
{Call} Choose one effect.
Give a rival Unit -2 power this turn. // Draw 1.
{Spend}: Decrease a Gig by up to 2.

rulings.q: When you are resolving the [Call] effect of Wakako Okada, can you choose "Give a rival Unit -2 power this turn" even if there are no rival Units?
When you resolve the [Spend Icon:] effect on Wakako Okada, can you choose a min Gig?

name: We Gotta Live Together
ability_text:
If a Rival controls at least 2 more Gigs than you, play this Program for 3 €$.
Play up to 2 Units with cost 3 or less from your trash for free.

rulings.q: If you spend 3 €$ to play this Program, will the cost value change from 5 to 3?
Can you choose to spend 5 €$ instead of 3 €$ if your Rival controls at least 2 more gigs than you?

name: Westbrook Netrunner
ability_text: {Play} Until your next turn, rival Legends can't steal friendly Gigs with value less than their power.

rulings.q: If your Rival plays a Legend to the Field area after you played a Westbrook Netrunner, can the Rival Legend steal a gig with a lower value than its power?

You played a Westbrook Netrunner, resolved its [Play] effect, and ended your turn. During your rival's next turn, they use an effect to defeat your Westbrook Netrunner. Can the rival Legends now steal a Gig with a value lower than their power during that turn?

name: Wild in the Streets
ability_text: Defeat a spent Unit.

rulings.q: Can you pay the cost to play this Program even if no Units are spent in the Field areas?
Can you choose a friendly Unit with the Wild in the Streets effect?
If you play this Program and there is only a spent friendly Unit in the Field area. Will you then be forced to choose and defeat your own spent Unit?

name: Wraith Marauders
ability_text: When this Unit steals a Gig, ready another friendly Unit with power equal to the Gig's value.

rulings.q: When you steal a Gig with a Wraith Marauders, does the effect force you to ready a friendly Unit with power equal to the Gig's value?

name: Yorinobu Arasaka - Embracing Destruction
ability_text: The first time a friendly ARASAKA Unit attacks each turn, draw 1. Then, if you have less than 20 ☆ (Street Cred), discard 1.

rulings.q: You've already attacked with a friendly ARASAKA Unit this turn and then called a friendly Yorinobu Arasaka Legend face-up. Can Yorinobu Arasaka's effect trigger if you attack with another friendly ARASAKA Unit this turn?
If you've already attacked with a friendly ARASAKA Unit this turn, will Yorinobu Arasaka's effect trigger a second time if another friendly ARASAKA Unit attacks?

name: Yorinobu Arasaka - Steel Dragon
ability_text:
{Play} You may play a Unit with cost 4 or less from your hand or trash for free. It can attack rival Units this turn.
The first time an ARASAKA Unit is defeated each turn, draw 1.

rulings.q: If the Unit Yorinobu is playing has [ADRENALINE], can it attack the rival Gig area this turn?
When Yorinobu Arasaka is defeated, if it's the first time an ARASAKA Unit is defeated this turn, will Yorinobu Arasaka's effect trigger?
If an ARASAKA Unit was defeated this turn and you then play a Yorinobu Arasaka, will Yorinobu Arasaka's effect trigger if another ARASAKA Unit is defeated this turn?
Does the [Play] effect of Yorinobu Arasaka, "It can attack rival Units this turn," allow the Unit to declare an attack on a ready rival Unit this turn?
rulings.a: No. You still need a spent rival Unit as a valid attack target.

name: Zetatech Berserk
ability_text: Play this Gear for -1 €$ for each friendly face-up Legend, to a minimum of 1 €$.

rulings.q: When you play this Gear, the effect only reduces the €$ required to play the card; it does not change its cost value.
If a Unit or Legend is equipped with a Gear, does that Unit or Legend gain the Gear's tags?

name: Zetatech Faceplate
ability_text:
(Equip to a friendly Unit or face-up Legend.)
When this Unit or Legend is spent, adjust a Gig by up to 1. Then, if you control 3 or more Gigs with different values, draw 1.

rulings.q: When a friendly Unit equipped with a Zetatech Faceplate is spent when declaring an attack, can you resolve the Zetatech Faceplate's triggered effect before the React step and before the attack ends?

When you spend a friendly Unit with the [Attack] keyword to declare an attack while equipped with Zetatech Faceplate, both effects trigger at the same time. Can you choose the order in which to resolve the two now-pending effects?

When you choose to activate the [Spend Icon:] on a friendly Unit or Legend, the equipped Zetatech Faceplate's effect will trigger. Can you resolve the now pending Zetatech Faceplate effect before the activated [Spend Icon] effect?

When paying the cost to play a card or activate an effect, you spend a friendly face-up Legend, triggering the effect of the equipped Zetatech Faceplate. Can you resolve the now-pending Zetatech Faceplate effect before you finish resolving the activated Program?
